about: Generated by scripts/build-whos-older.ts from src/data/whos-older/*.source.json and the site's people data; do not edit.

characters.label: Adam
characters.when: Formed from the dust before anyone else (Genesis 2:7). The genealogies of Genesis 5 begin with him.
characters.brief: The first man, created by God

characters.label: Eve
characters.when: Made from Adam's side, after Adam (Genesis 2:22). Mother of Cain, Abel and Seth.
characters.brief: First woman; wife of Adam; tempted by the serpent.

characters.label: Cain
characters.when: Adam and Eve's first son (Genesis 4:1), at the very start of the Bible's story.
characters.brief: Adam and Eve's firstborn son, killed his brother Abel

characters.label: Abel
characters.when: Adam and Eve's second son, born after Cain (Genesis 4:2).
characters.brief: Adam and Eve's second son, killed by Cain

characters.label: Seth
characters.when: Born to Adam and Eve after Abel's death (Genesis 4:25), at the head of the line in Genesis 5.
characters.brief: Third son of Adam and Eve, ancestor of righteous line

characters.label: Enoch
characters.when: Seventh generation from Adam (Genesis 5:18; Jude 1:14), before the Flood.
characters.brief: A righteous man who walked with God.

characters.label: Methuselah
characters.when: Enoch's son, eighth generation from Adam (Genesis 5:21), before the Flood.
characters.brief: The oldest person mentioned in the Bible.

characters.label: Noah
characters.when: Tenth generation from Adam (Genesis 5:28–29). The Flood came in his six hundredth year.
characters.brief: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood

characters.label: Shem
characters.when: One of Noah's three sons, born before the Flood (Genesis 5:32); ten generations before Abraham (Genesis 11:10–26).
characters.brief: Noah's son, ancestor of Semitic peoples

characters.label: Terah
characters.when: Nine generations after Shem (Genesis 11:10–24), after the Flood; he left Ur for Haran.
characters.brief: Abraham's father who settled in Haran

characters.label: Abraham
characters.when: Born about 2215–1715 BC. The range covers the traditional, early and late dates for the Exodus, and both readings of Exodus 12:40.
characters.brief: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

characters.label: Sarah
characters.when: Ten years younger than Abraham (Genesis 17:17), so born about 2205–1705 BC, on the same range of Exodus dates.
characters.brief: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

characters.label: Hagar
characters.when: A young woman when she bore Ishmael in Abraham's 86th year (Genesis 16:16): born about 2170–1640 BC.
characters.brief: Sarah's Egyptian maidservant; mother of Ishmael.

characters.label: Lot
characters.when: A grown man when he set out with Abraham, then 75 (Genesis 12:4–5): born about 2220–1655 BC.
characters.brief: Abraham's nephew; rescued from Sodom's destruction

characters.label: Ishmael
characters.when: Born when Abraham was 86 (Genesis 16:16): about 2130–1625 BC.
characters.brief: Son of Abraham and Hagar; father of Arab tribes.

characters.label: Isaac
characters.when: Born when Abraham was 100 (Genesis 21:5): about 2115–1615 BC.
characters.brief: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

characters.label: Rebekah
characters.when: A young woman when Isaac, then 40, married her (Genesis 24:16; 25:20): born about 2105–1585 BC.
characters.brief: Wife of Isaac; mother of Jacob and Esau

characters.label: Laban
characters.when: Already a grown man when his sister Rebekah married Isaac (Genesis 24:29): born about 2155–1590 BC.
characters.brief: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

characters.label: Esau
characters.when: Born when Isaac was 60 (Genesis 25:26), just before his twin Jacob: about 2055–1555 BC.
characters.brief: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

characters.label: Jacob
characters.when: Born when Isaac was 60 (Genesis 25:26), and 130 when he went down to Egypt (Genesis 47:9): about 2055–1555 BC.
characters.brief: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

characters.label: Leah
characters.when: A young woman when she married Jacob in his eighties (Genesis 29): born about 2010–1480 BC.
characters.brief: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah

characters.label: Rachel
characters.when: Leah's younger sister (Genesis 29:16), married to Jacob in his eighties: born about 2010–1480 BC.
characters.brief: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

characters.label: Reuben
characters.when: Jacob's firstborn (Genesis 49:3), born in Haran a few years before Joseph: about 1970–1465 BC.
characters.brief: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

characters.label: Judah
characters.when: Leah's fourth son, born in Haran before Joseph (Genesis 29:35): about 1970–1465 BC.
characters.brief: Israelite tribe, kingdom, and province

characters.label: Joseph of Egypt
characters.when: Thirty when he stood before Pharaoh, and 39 when Jacob came to Egypt (Genesis 41:46; 45:6): born about 1960–1465 BC.
characters.brief: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

characters.label: Benjamin
characters.when: Jacob's youngest son, born on the road to Bethlehem (Genesis 35:16–18), a grown father of sons by the move to Egypt: about 1960–1440 BC.
characters.brief: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

characters.label: Manasseh (son of Joseph)
characters.when: Born in Egypt before the years of famine (Genesis 41:50–51): about 1930–1425 BC.
characters.brief: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

characters.label: Ephraim
characters.when: Born in Egypt before the years of famine, after Manasseh (Genesis 41:52): about 1930–1425 BC.
characters.brief: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

characters.label: Job
characters.when: Nobody knows when Job lived. By Ezekiel's day, about 593 BC, he was already a famous man of the past (Ezekiel 14:14).
characters.brief: A righteous man who endured great suffering

characters.label: Moses
characters.when: Eighty at the Exodus (Exodus 7:7). Born about 1575–1290 BC: the range covers the traditional, early and late dates for the Exodus.
characters.brief: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

characters.label: Aaron
characters.when: Eighty-three at the Exodus (Exodus 7:7): born about 1575–1290 BC, on every Exodus date.
characters.brief: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

characters.label: Miriam
characters.when: A grown woman who led the singing after the Red Sea (Exodus 15:20): born about 1600–1225 BC.
characters.brief: Moses' sister, a prophetess who led women in worship.

characters.label: Jethro
characters.when: Father of grown daughters when Moses came to Midian at forty (Exodus 2:16; Acts 7:23): born about 1630–1280 BC.
characters.brief: Moses' father-in-law, priest of Midian

characters.label: Joshua
characters.when: Moses' young assistant who already led the army (Exodus 17:9; 33:11): born about 1535–1220 BC, on every Exodus date.
characters.brief: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

characters.label: Caleb
characters.when: Forty when Moses sent him to spy out the land, the year after the Exodus (Joshua 14:7): born about 1530–1245 BC.
characters.brief: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance

characters.label: Korah
characters.when: A leading man who rebelled against Moses in the wilderness (Numbers 16): born about 1580–1190 BC.
characters.brief: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants

characters.label: Balaam
characters.when: Hired to curse Israel at the end of the forty years in the wilderness (Numbers 22): born about 1540–1190 BC.
characters.brief: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

characters.label: Rahab
characters.when: A grown woman when Israel crossed the Jordan, forty years after the Exodus (Joshua 2): born about 1510–1185 BC.
characters.brief: A Canaanite woman who helped the Israelite spies in Jericho

characters.label: Othniel
characters.when: A warrior at the conquest (Joshua 15:17), later the first judge: born about 1525–1180 BC.
characters.brief: First judge of Israel, Caleb's nephew

characters.label: Ehud
characters.when: A judge after Joshua's death. After his victory came eighty years of rest and twenty of Jabin before Deborah (Judges 3:30; 4:1–3): born about 1505–1190 BC.
characters.brief: Left-handed Benjamite judge who delivered Israel from Moabite oppression

characters.label: Deborah
characters.when: A judge after Joshua's death. Forty years of rest and seven of Midian came between her and Gideon (Judges 5:31; 6:1): born about 1505–1170 BC.
characters.brief: Prophetess and judge who led Israel to victory over Canaanites.

characters.label: Gideon
characters.when: A judge after Joshua's death. Forty years of rest, then Abimelech, Tola and Jair, came after his victory and before the kings (Judges 8:28–10:5): born about 1505–1125 BC.
characters.brief: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.

characters.label: Jephthah
characters.when: A judge after Joshua's death, followed by Ibzan, Elon and Abdon before the kings (Judges 12:7–14): born about 1505–1065 BC.
characters.brief: A judge of Israel, known for his tragic vow.

characters.label: Samson
characters.when: A judge in the days of the Philistines, before Israel had a king (Judges 13–16): born about 1505–1035 BC.
characters.brief: Israelite judge with great strength from God

characters.label: Naomi
characters.when: Lived when the judges ruled (Ruth 1:1); her sons were grown and married: born about 1525–1090 BC.
characters.brief: Israelite woman, mother-in-law of Ruth.

characters.label: Ruth
characters.when: Lived when the judges ruled, three generations before David (Ruth 1:1; 4:17): born about 1465–1075 BC.
characters.brief: Moabite woman, ancestor of David and Jesus

characters.label: Boaz
characters.when: Lived when the judges ruled; David's great-grandfather (Ruth 4:21–22): born about 1515–1075 BC.
characters.brief: Kinsman-redeemer who married Ruth, ancestor of David and Jesus

characters.label: Eli
characters.when: Died at 98, at least twenty years before Saul became king (1 Samuel 4:15; 7:2): born about 1295–1140 BC.
characters.brief: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

characters.label: Hannah
characters.when: Samuel's mother (1 Samuel 1:20): born about 1245–1070 BC.
characters.brief: The mother of the prophet Samuel.

characters.label: Samuel
characters.when: Old and gray when Saul became king (1 Samuel 12:2): born about 1195–1060 BC.
characters.brief: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

characters.label: Jesse
characters.when: Already old in Saul's day, with eight sons (1 Samuel 17:12): born about 1170–1050 BC.
characters.brief: Father of King David.

characters.label: Saul
characters.when: A grown man with a son old enough to command when he became king, about 1095–1020 BC on the different systems (1 Samuel 13:1–2): born about 1175–1035 BC.
characters.brief: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

characters.label: Jonathan
characters.when: Already commanding a thousand men early in Saul's reign (1 Samuel 13:2): born about 1155–1035 BC.
characters.brief: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

characters.label: Goliath
characters.when: A warrior from his youth when David was still a boy (1 Samuel 17:33): born about 1170–1030 BC.
characters.brief: A Philistine giant defeated by David.

characters.label: David
characters.when: Thirty when he became king (2 Samuel 5:4): born about 1085 BC (Ussher), 1040 BC (Thiele–McFall) or 1032 BC (Albright).
characters.brief: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

characters.label: Bathsheba
characters.when: A young wife when David saw her, years into his reign in Jerusalem (2 Samuel 11): born about 1090–975 BC.
characters.brief: Wife of Uriah, later married David and bore Solomon.

characters.label: Absalom
characters.when: Born in Hebron during David's first seven years as king (2 Samuel 3:2–5): about 1055–995 BC.
characters.brief: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

characters.label: Solomon
characters.when: Born in Jerusalem during David's reign there, and king when young (2 Samuel 5:14; 1 Kings 3:7): born about 1050–975 BC.
characters.brief: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

characters.label: Nathan (prophet)
characters.when: A grown prophet in David's reign (2 Samuel 7:2): born about 1135–975 BC.
characters.brief: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.

characters.label: Rehoboam
characters.when: Forty-one when he became king (1 Kings 14:21): born about 1015 BC (Ussher) to 965 BC (Albright).
characters.brief: Son of Solomon, first king of Judah

characters.label: Jeroboam I
characters.when: A grown man when he became king, about 975 BC (Ussher) or 931–922 BC (Thiele–McFall, Albright): born about 1055–940 BC.
characters.brief: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

characters.label: Asa
characters.when: King from about 955 BC (Ussher) or 913–911 BC (Albright, Thiele–McFall): born about 1035–925 BC.
characters.brief: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat

characters.label: Jehoshaphat
characters.when: Thirty-five when he became king (1 Kings 22:42): born about 950 BC (Ussher) or 908 BC (Thiele–McFall).
characters.brief: Son of Asa, king of Judah.

characters.label: Omri
characters.when: A grown army commander when he became king, about 929 BC (Ussher) or 885–876 BC: born about 1010–890 BC.
characters.brief: King of Israel; father of Ahab

characters.label: Ahab
characters.when: King from about 918 BC (Ussher) or 874–869 BC: born about 1000–885 BC.
characters.brief: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

characters.label: Jezebel
characters.when: A grown woman in Ahab's reign, about 918–850 BC on the different systems (1 Kings 16:31): born about 1000–865 BC.
characters.brief: Queen of Israel; wife of King Ahab

characters.label: Elijah
characters.when: A grown prophet in Ahab's reign, about 918–850 BC on the different systems (1 Kings 17:1): born about 1000–865 BC.
characters.brief: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

characters.label: Elisha
characters.when: A grown man ploughing his field when Elijah called him, in Ahab's reign (1 Kings 19:19): born about 1000–855 BC.
characters.brief: A prophet who succeeded Elijah.

characters.label: Jehu
characters.when: A grown army commander when he became king, about 884 BC (Ussher) or 842–841 BC: born about 965–855 BC.
characters.brief: Son of Jehoshaphat, king of Israel, destroyed Ahab's dynasty.

characters.label: Athaliah
characters.when: A grown woman who seized the throne about 884 BC (Ussher) or 842–841 BC (2 Kings 11:1–3): born about 965–855 BC.
characters.brief: Queen of Judah, daughter of Ahab

characters.label: Joash (king of Judah)
characters.when: Seven when he became king (2 Kings 11:21): born about 885 BC (Ussher) or 842 BC (Thiele–McFall).
characters.brief: King of Judah, son of Ahaziah

characters.label: Jonah
characters.when: A prophet in the reign of Jeroboam II, about 836–746 BC on the different systems (2 Kings 14:25): born about 915–760 BC.
characters.brief: Prophet swallowed by fish, preached to Nineveh

characters.label: Jeroboam II
characters.when: King from about 836 BC (Ussher) or 793–786 BC: born about 915–800 BC.
characters.brief: King of Israel, son of Jehoash.

characters.label: Uzziah
characters.when: Sixteen when he became king (2 Kings 15:2): born about 826 BC (Ussher) to 799 BC (Albright).
characters.brief: King of Judah, reigned 52 years

characters.label: Amos
characters.when: A prophet in the days of Uzziah, about 810–739 BC on the different systems (Amos 1:1): born about 890–755 BC.
characters.brief: Prophet from Tekoa who prophesied to Israel

characters.label: Hosea
characters.when: A prophet in the days of Uzziah and Jeroboam II (Hosea 1:1): born about 915–755 BC.
characters.brief: A prophet to the northern kingdom of Israel.

characters.label: Isaiah
characters.when: A grown prophet by the year King Uzziah died (Isaiah 6:1). Uzziah's reign runs about 810–739 BC on the different systems: born about 890–755 BC.
characters.brief: Prophet during reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah.

characters.label: Micah (prophet)
characters.when: A prophet in the days of Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah (Micah 1:1): born about 840–745 BC.
characters.brief: A prophet from Moresheth during the reigns of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah.

characters.label: Ahaz
characters.when: Twenty when he became king (2 Kings 16:2): born about 762 BC (Ussher) or 755 BC (Thiele–McFall, Albright).
characters.brief: King of Judah, son of Jotham

characters.label: Hezekiah
characters.when: Twenty-five when he became king (2 Kings 18:2): born about 754 BC (Thiele–McFall) to 740 BC (Albright).
characters.brief: A righteous king of Judah.

characters.label: Manasseh (king)
characters.when: Twelve when he became king (2 Kings 21:1): born about 710 BC (Ussher) to 699 BC (Albright).
characters.brief: King of Judah, son of Hezekiah.

characters.label: Nahum
characters.when: Prophesied after Thebes fell in 663 BC (Nahum 3:8) and before Nineveh fell in 612 BC: born about 745–625 BC.
characters.brief: Old Testament prophet, author of the Book of Nahum.

characters.label: Josiah
characters.when: Eight when he became king (2 Kings 22:1): born about 649 BC (Ussher, Thiele–McFall) or 648 BC (Albright).
characters.brief: King of Judah known for his religious reforms

characters.label: Huldah
characters.when: A prophetess in Josiah's reign, about 641–609 BC (2 Kings 22:14): born about 720–625 BC.
characters.brief: A prophetess during the reign of King Josiah.

characters.label: Zephaniah
characters.when: A prophet in Josiah's reign, about 641–609 BC (Zephaniah 1:1): born about 720–625 BC.
characters.brief: Prophet, son of Cushi, descendant of Hezekiah

characters.label: Jeremiah
characters.when: Called young in Josiah's thirteenth year, about 627 BC (Jeremiah 1:2, 6). The window is kept as wide as Josiah's whole reign: born about 720–625 BC.
characters.brief: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

characters.label: Habakkuk
characters.when: Prophesied as the Chaldeans rose to power, about 626–597 BC (Habakkuk 1:6): born about 705–610 BC.
characters.brief: A prophet who questioned God's justice.

characters.label: Jehoiakim
characters.when: Twenty-five when he became king (2 Kings 23:36): born about 635–634 BC.
characters.brief: King of Judah, son of Josiah

characters.label: Jehoiachin
characters.when: Eighteen when he became king, or eight in Chronicles (2 Kings 24:8; 2 Chronicles 36:9): born about 625–605 BC.
characters.brief: King of Judah, son of Jehoiakim

characters.label: Zedekiah
characters.when: Twenty-one when he became king (2 Kings 24:18): born about 620–618 BC.
characters.brief: Last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile

characters.label: Nebuchadnezzar
characters.when: Already commanding Babylon's army at Carchemish in 605 BC, the year he became king (Jeremiah 46:2): born about 640–625 BC.
characters.brief: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah

characters.label: Daniel
characters.when: Taken to Babylon as a youth in Jehoiakim's third year, about 607–605 BC (Daniel 1:1–6). The window is kept as wide as Jehoiakim's reign: born about 690–615 BC.
characters.brief: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

characters.label: Shadrach
characters.when: Taken to Babylon as a youth with Daniel, about 607–605 BC (Daniel 1:3–7): born about 640–615 BC.
characters.brief: One of Daniel's three friends in Babylon.

characters.label: Meshach
characters.when: Taken to Babylon as a youth with Daniel, about 607–605 BC (Daniel 1:3–7): born about 640–615 BC.
characters.brief: A Jewish exile in Babylon, friend of Daniel.

characters.label: Abednego
characters.when: Taken to Babylon as a youth with Daniel, about 607–605 BC (Daniel 1:3–7): born about 640–615 BC.
characters.brief: One of Daniel's companions, survived the fiery furnace

characters.label: Ezekiel
characters.when: Carried to Babylon with King Jehoiachin in 597 BC (Ezekiel 1:2–3): born about 690–610 BC.
characters.brief: Prophet during Babylonian exile; author of the Book of Ezekiel.

characters.label: Belshazzar
characters.when: Ruled Babylon from about 556–553 BC until its fall in 539 BC (Daniel 5): born about 635–570 BC.
characters.brief: The last Emperor of Babylon, son of Nabonidus.

characters.label: Darius the Mede
characters.when: About sixty-two when he received the kingdom in 539–538 BC (Daniel 5:31): born about 600 BC.
characters.brief: Mede who became Emperor over Babylon

characters.label: Cyrus
characters.when: King of Anshan from 559 BC and of Babylon from 539 BC (Ezra 1:1): born about 605–580 BC by the ancient writers; the window is kept wider.
characters.brief: Persian Emperor who decreed the rebuilding of the Temple

characters.label: Zerubbabel
characters.when: Led the first return about 538 BC as a grown leader (Ezra 2:2): born about 620–550 BC.
characters.brief: Leader of the first Jewish exiles from Babylon

characters.label: Joshua (high priest)
characters.when: High priest at the first return about 538 BC (Ezra 3:2; Haggai 1:1): born about 620–550 BC.
characters.brief: High priest during the rebuilding of the temple

characters.label: Haggai
characters.when: Prophesied in the second year of Darius, 520 BC (Haggai 1:1): born about 600–500 BC.
characters.brief: A prophet who encouraged the rebuilding of the temple.

characters.label: Zechariah (prophet)
characters.when: Prophesied in the second year of Darius, 520 BC (Zechariah 1:1): born about 600–500 BC.
characters.brief: Post-exilic prophet who wrote the book of Zechariah

characters.label: Darius the Great
characters.when: King of Persia from 522 BC (Ezra 4:24); born about 550 BC by Herodotus.
characters.brief: Persian king who decreed the rebuilding of the Temple

characters.label: Xerxes
characters.when: Ahasuerus of the book of Esther, king from 486 BC (Esther 1:1): born about 518 BC.
characters.brief: Persian Emperor (probably Xerxes I); husband of Esther

characters.label: Esther
characters.when: A young woman brought to King Xerxes in his seventh year, 479–478 BC (Esther 2:16): born about 510–490 BC.
characters.brief: Jewish queen of Persia; saved her people from genocide.

characters.label: Mordecai
characters.when: A grown man who brought up his cousin Esther (Esther 2:7), and an official of Xerxes about 479–473 BC: born about 615–495 BC.
characters.brief: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

characters.label: Haman
characters.when: Chief official of Xerxes about 474 BC (Esther 3:1, 7): born about 570–495 BC.
characters.brief: A Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews.

characters.label: Ezra
characters.when: Came to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes, 458 BC (or 398 BC if Artaxerxes II is meant) (Ezra 7:7): born about 540–425 BC.
characters.brief: Priest; scribe; led a group of exiles back to Jerusalem.

characters.label: Nehemiah
characters.when: Cupbearer to King Artaxerxes in his twentieth year, 445 BC (Nehemiah 2:1): born about 525–460 BC.
characters.brief: Governor of Judah, rebuilt Jerusalem's walls.

characters.label: Artaxerxes
characters.when: King from 465 BC (or from 404 BC, if Ezra's Artaxerxes is the second of that name): born about 545–420 BC.
characters.brief: Persian king during Ezra and Nehemiah's time

characters.label: Malachi
characters.when: Prophesied after the temple was rebuilt in 515 BC (Malachi 1:10): born about 595–415 BC.
characters.brief: Prophet who wrote the book bearing his name.

characters.label: Joel (prophet)
characters.when: His book names no king. Proposed dates run from the ninth century BC to after the exile: born about 930–415 BC.
characters.brief: A prophet of Judah and the author of the Book of Joel

characters.label: Obadiah (prophet)
characters.when: His book names no king. Proposed dates run from about 850 BC to soon after Jerusalem fell in 586 BC: born about 930–565 BC.
characters.brief: Prophet who prophesied against Edom

characters.label: Herod the Great
characters.when: King from 37 BC; he died in 4 BC aged about seventy (Josephus): born about 74 BC.
characters.brief: The Great, Roman-appointed king of Judea during Jesus' birth.

characters.label: Caesar Augustus
characters.when: Emperor when Jesus was born (Luke 2:1); born in 63 BC.
characters.brief: Roman emperor during the birth of Jesus

characters.label: Herod Antipas
characters.when: Herod the Great's son, ruler of Galilee from 4 BC (Luke 3:1): born about 20 BC.
characters.brief: Tetrarch of Galilee during Jesus' ministry.

characters.label: Anna
characters.when: Eighty-four or older when Jesus was brought to the temple, about 8–1 BC (Luke 2:36–37): born about 120–85 BC.
characters.brief: Prophetess who witnessed Jesus' dedication in the temple

characters.label: Zechariah (priest)
characters.when: An old man when John the Baptist was promised (Luke 1:18): born about 110–40 BC.
characters.brief: Priest, father of John the Baptist

characters.label: Elizabeth
characters.when: Conceived John the Baptist in her old age (Luke 1:36): born about 100–35 BC.
characters.brief: The wife of Zechariah and mother of John the Baptist.

characters.label: Joseph of Nazareth
characters.when: A grown man betrothed to Mary when Jesus was born, about 8–1 BC (Matthew 1:18): born about 90–15 BC.
characters.brief: Husband of Mary and earthly father of Jesus

characters.label: Mary (mother of Jesus)
characters.when: A young woman betrothed to Joseph when Jesus was born, about 8–1 BC (Luke 1:27): born about 40–13 BC.
characters.brief: Mother of Jesus; wife of Joseph.

characters.label: John the Baptist
characters.when: Born about six months before Jesus, in the days of Herod the Great (Luke 1:5, 36): about 9–2 BC.
characters.brief: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

characters.label: Caiaphas
characters.when: High priest about AD 18–36 (John 11:49): born about 63 BC – 3 BC.
characters.brief: High priest during Jesus' ministry and trial

characters.label: Pontius Pilate
characters.when: Governor of Judea about AD 26–36 (Luke 3:1): born about 55 BC – AD 11.
characters.brief: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

characters.label: Peter
characters.when: A married working man when Jesus called him, about AD 26–33 (Mark 1:16, 30): born about 55 BC – AD 20.
characters.brief: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

characters.label: Andrew
characters.when: A working fisherman when Jesus called him, about AD 26–33 (Mark 1:16): born about 55 BC – AD 20.
characters.brief: Apostle, brother of Simon Peter

characters.label: James (son of Zebedee)
characters.when: A working fisherman when Jesus called him, about AD 26–33 (Mark 1:19): born about 55 BC – AD 20.
characters.brief: Son of Zebedee, one of the Twelve Apostles

characters.label: John (son of Zebedee)
characters.when: A working fisherman when Jesus called him, about AD 26–33 (Mark 1:19): born about 55 BC – AD 20.
characters.brief: Apostle and son of Zebedee

characters.label: Matthew
characters.when: A tax collector at work when Jesus called him, about AD 26–33 (Matthew 9:9): born about 55 BC – AD 20.
characters.brief: Apostle, tax collector, author of the Gospel of Matthew.

characters.label: Thomas
characters.when: A grown disciple in Jesus' ministry, about AD 26–33 (John 11:16): born about 55 BC – AD 20.
characters.brief: One of Jesus' twelve disciples, known for doubting

characters.label: Mary Magdalene
characters.when: A grown woman who supported Jesus' ministry, about AD 26–33 (Luke 8:2–3): born about 55 BC – AD 20.
characters.brief: Follower of Jesus, first witness of His resurrection.

characters.label: Lazarus
characters.when: A grown man and friend of Jesus, about AD 26–33 (John 11:1–5): born about 55 BC – AD 20.
characters.brief: Brother of Mary and Martha; raised from the dead

characters.label: Martha
characters.when: A grown woman who welcomed Jesus into her home, about AD 26–33 (Luke 10:38): born about 55 BC – AD 20.
characters.brief: Sister of Mary and Lazarus, hosted Jesus.

characters.label: Nicodemus
characters.when: A ruler of the Jews in Jesus' ministry, about AD 26–33 (John 3:1): born about 55 BC – AD 20.
characters.brief: Pharisee who visited Jesus

characters.label: Zacchaeus
characters.when: A rich chief tax collector in Jesus' ministry, about AD 26–33 (Luke 19:2): born about 55 BC – AD 20.
characters.brief: Tax collector who hosted Jesus in Jericho

characters.label: Gamaliel
characters.when: A teacher honoured by all the people about AD 33 (Acts 5:34): born about 58 BC – AD 3.
characters.brief: Pharisee; teacher of the law; Paul's mentor.

characters.label: Stephen
characters.when: A grown man chosen to serve the church, about AD 31–36 (Acts 6:5): born about 50 BC – AD 21.
characters.brief: One of seven deacons, full of faith, performed miracles, martyred.

characters.label: Barnabas
characters.when: A grown man who sold a field for the church, about AD 31–36 (Acts 4:36–37): born about 50 BC – AD 21.
characters.brief: A Levite from Cyprus who accompanied Paul on missionary journeys.

characters.label: Cornelius
characters.when: A centurion with a household, about AD 36–41 (Acts 10:1–2): born about 45 BC – AD 21.
characters.brief: Centurion, first Gentile convert to Christianity

characters.label: Dorcas
characters.when: A grown woman known for her good works, about AD 36–41 (Acts 9:36): born about 65 BC – AD 26.
characters.brief: Charitable woman in Joppa whom Peter raised from the dead

characters.label: Paul
characters.when: A young man at Stephen's death, about AD 31–37, already acting with the chief priests' authority (Acts 7:58; 26:10): born about 10 BC – AD 17.
characters.brief: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

characters.label: Mark
characters.when: Went with Barnabas and Paul about AD 44–48 (Acts 12:25): born about 37 BC – AD 36.
characters.brief: Barnabas's relative (KJV "sister's son", RV "cousin"); Paul's companion

characters.label: Silas
characters.when: A leading man of the Jerusalem church about AD 49–51 (Acts 15:22): born about 32 BC – AD 36.
characters.brief: Prominent member of the Jerusalem church, companion of Paul.

characters.label: Lydia
characters.when: A businesswoman with a household when Paul came to Philippi, about AD 49–51 (Acts 16:14–15): born about 32 BC – AD 36.
characters.brief: Seller of purple goods; converted by Paul in Philippi

characters.label: Luke
characters.when: Travelled with Paul from about AD 49–51 (Colossians 4:14; Acts 16:10): born about 32 BC – AD 36.
characters.brief: Physician; companion of Paul; author of Luke and Acts

characters.label: Priscilla
characters.when: A married woman in Corinth about AD 49–51 (Acts 18:2): born about 32 BC – AD 36.
characters.brief: Early Christian teacher; wife of Aquila

characters.label: Aquila
characters.when: A married tradesman in Corinth about AD 49–51 (Acts 18:2): born about 32 BC – AD 36.
characters.brief: Jewish Christian tentmaker, co-worker with Paul

characters.label: Titus
characters.when: Went up to Jerusalem as a grown believer about AD 48–49 (Galatians 2:1–3): born about 33 BC – AD 34.
characters.brief: Gentile convert and companion of Paul

characters.label: Apollos
characters.when: A learned teacher in Ephesus about AD 52–54 (Acts 18:24): born about 29 BC – AD 39.
characters.brief: Eloquent Jewish Christian from Alexandria, co-worker with Paul

characters.label: Felix
characters.when: Governor of Judea about AD 52–60 (Acts 24): born about 29 BC – AD 37.
characters.brief: Roman governor of Judea; heard Paul's case.

characters.label: Festus
characters.when: Governor of Judea from about AD 59–60 (Acts 24:27): born about 22 BC – AD 45.
characters.brief: Roman governor of Judea; heard Paul's case; sent him to Rome.

characters.label: Herod Agrippa I
characters.when: Herod the Great's grandson, king from AD 37 (Acts 12:1); born about 11–10 BC.
characters.brief: A king who persecuted the early church.

characters.label: King Agrippa
characters.when: Agrippa II, who heard Paul about AD 59–60 (Acts 25:13); born about AD 27–28.
characters.brief: King who heard Paul's defense in Caesarea

characters.label: Lois
characters.when: Timothy's grandmother (2 Timothy 1:5): born about 80 BC – AD 11.
characters.brief: Grandmother of Timothy; commended for her faith

characters.label: Eunice
characters.when: Timothy's mother (Acts 16:1; 2 Timothy 1:5): born about 31 BC – AD 23.
characters.brief: Mother of Timothy; a Jewish believer.

characters.label: Timothy
characters.when: A disciple when Paul met him about AD 48–50, still told not to let anyone despise his youth about AD 62–67 (Acts 16:1; 1 Timothy 4:12): born about AD 20–35.
characters.brief: Paul's young disciple and co-worker

characters.label: Philemon
characters.when: A householder who hosted a church when Paul wrote to him, about AD 57–62 (Philemon 1:1–2): born about 24 BC – AD 47.
characters.brief: Recipient of Paul's letter, Colossian slave owner

characters.label: Onesimus
characters.when: A runaway servant who met Paul about AD 57–62 (Philemon 1:10): born about 24 BC – AD 50.
characters.brief: Runaway slave, convert of Paul

characters.label: Epaphras
characters.when: A grown minister of the church in Colossae, about AD 57–62 (Colossians 1:7): born about 24 BC – AD 47.
characters.brief: A faithful minister and fellow servant of Paul.
